designPrinciple: 1-File / 1-Domain Strict Responsibility Matrix. Zero Hardcoding. Single Source of Truth.

core/config.js.responsibility: Firebase SDK initialization, project configuration, and environment flags.

core/auth.js.responsibility: Authentication state listener, anonymous bypass, and user session management.

core/channels.js.responsibility: Canonical 3-letter OTA channel registry (Channex standard), code normalization, display resolvers, and accounting key derivation.

core/dates.js.responsibility: Zero-drift UTC day parsing, local YMD formatters, date arithmetic, and calendar labels.

core/money.js.responsibility: Financial rounding, currency symbol resolution, VAT splits, PAX division, and balance math.

core/occupancy.js.responsibility: The Occupancy Law: collision detection rules, status lifecycle cycles, and occupancy classification.

core/properties.js.responsibility: Canonical property ID normalization, property catalog loading/saving, and active profile resolution.

core/ui-dialogs.js.responsibility: Unified alert modals, non-blocking toast notifications, and interactive confirmation popups.

core/audit-rooms.js.responsibility: Inventory structural integrity auditing, orphan reservation recovery, and capacity mismatch reconciliation.

core/health-audit.js.responsibility: Shared Setup & Channel Manager configuration auditor: detects unlinked categories, orphaned ripple links, broken Channex mappings, and invalid promo scopes.

channex.js.responsibility: Two-way Channex API integration: rate limiting (18 req/min), contiguous date range compression, and outbox ARI dispatching[cite: 1].

parser/parser-engine.js.responsibility: Master clipboard/text extraction router, universal date normalizer, and fallback estimator.

parser/room-assigner.js.responsibility: Intelligent room assignment: category matching, zero-overlap verification, Event Tetris turnaround grouping, and dorm clustering.

parser/ota-booking.js.responsibility: Booking.com extranet and email regex extractor: guest, dates, bookDate, units, explicit net, BDC proxy tagging, and special requests.

parser/ota-agoda.js.responsibility: Agoda YCS and confirmation parser: guest, nationality, dates, net payout, UPC prepaid markers, and special requests.

parser/ota-hostelworld.js.responsibility: Hostelworld parser: reference IDs, guest nationality, unit/bed count, deposit (HW-KP), and arrival balance due.

parser/ota-airbnb.js.responsibility: Airbnb parser: reservation code, guest count, 100% prepaid payout classification, and contact restriction flags.

parser/ota-expedia.js.responsibility: Expedia Partner Central parser: itinerary IDs, guest nationality, unit count, and Expedia Collect vs Hotel Collect net extraction.

pms/pms-init.js.responsibility: PMS frame bootstrapper, zero-hardcoded property resolution, realtime Firestore snapshots, view switcher, and search[cite: 3].

pms/pms-calendar-grid.js.responsibility: Master calendar assembly, sticky room sidebar, header date grids, thermal availability calculation, and category collapse toggles.
functions: renderCategoryAvailabilityRow(catName, grpKey, roomList, daysArray, propBookings, daysToShow)

pms/pms-calendar-bars.js.responsibility: Reservation bar DOM rendering, CSS pixel positioning, multi-night width math, OTA channel icons, and interactive hover tooltips.
functions: renderReservationBar(booking, daysToShow, getDayIndexFn, todayStr, yesterdayStr, onOpenModalFn, searchTerm)

pms/pms-calendar-tape.js.responsibility: Timeline horizontal navigation, today centering, jump-month selector synchronization, and day-column width zoom toggle[cite: 2].

pms/pms-folio-modal.js.responsibility: Guest folio modal lifecycle, form data binding, room select populator, status cycling, date nudging, and dialog dragging.

pms/pms-folio-ledger.js.responsibility: Ledger financial calculations, payment rows, bad CC toggling, itemized extra charges, stay extensions, and dynamic rate checking.

pms/pms-folio-actions.js.responsibility: Reservation mutations: save with overlap collision guards, contiguous merges, true nightly rate splits, and early checkout reversals.

pms/pms-folio-invoice.js.responsibility: Dynamic, printable branded HTML/PDF guest folio invoice generator with classified OTA vs direct payments and add-on items.

pms/pms-dashboard.js.responsibility: Operational daily overview: arrivals, departures, stayovers, live rates card, event package pricing, and overdue departure alerts.

pms/pms-database.js.responsibility: Tabular guest database ledger: multi-column sorting, category-aware room filters, date presets, search, and bulk deletion.

pms/pms-tm30.js.responsibility: Thai Immigration Section 38 batch reporting engine: foreigner filtering, missing passport auditing, CSV generation, and filing logs.

cm/cm-init.js.responsibility: Channel Manager bootstrapper, pricing matrix loader, channel connection status, and dirty state save indicators.

cm/cm-matrix-grid.js.responsibility: Interactive rates and restrictions calendar grid: cell price inline editing, rate plan expansion, and thermal occupancy scales.

cm/cm-ripple.js.responsibility: Bidirectional relational pricing propagation engine: calculates linked rate plans from base anchors using multipliers and offsets.

cm/cm-bulk-drawer.js.responsibility: Unified Range Bulk Update, Ripple Recovery (Fill Blanks / Re-Ripple All), Event Date Manager & Event Curve/Pyramid Tuner.

cm/cm-promos.js.responsibility: Margin-preserving OTA promotional discount calculator: models channel take rates against discounts to protect floor margins.

cm/cm-auditor.js.responsibility: Discrepancy checker: cross-references PMS reservations against Channex logs to catch unrecorded OTA bookings or rate mismatches.

setup/setup-wizard.js.responsibility: The Setup Orchestrator: 5-step onboarding stepper, step validation guards, Firestore configuration persistence, and navigation.

setup/setup-profile.js.responsibility: Step 1: Property profile, legal business entity, display currency, branding assets, tax/VAT rates, and default channel commissions.

setup/setup-rooms.js.responsibility: Step 2: Physical inventory builder: rooms, dorms, canonical № bed IDs, immutable category IDs, automatic rename cascading, drag-sorting, and relocation.

setup/setup-mapping.js.responsibility: Step 3: Channex channel and room-type mapper: pulls live OTA inventory IDs and binds them to PMS physical categories.

setup/setup-pricing.js.responsibility: Step 4: Rate plan architectures, standard anchors, channel markups, non-refundable discount spreads, and event peak calendars.
